verdict.rationale: Postman publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for its own API (confirmed via probe at learning.postman.com/openapi.json) and its Spec Hub/API Design tools let users design and export API specs in OpenAPI or Postman Collection format, both of which are machine-readable and consumable by AI agents. Missing for 10: no explicit doc demonstrating a one-click 'export as OpenAPI' user workflow or independent hands-on confirmation that exported specs are broadly interoperable.
